article.title: An Important Message from John Bellamy Foster
article.author: John Bellamy Foster
article.content: Monthly Review will continue to address the structural crises of capitalism and humanity’s necessary struggle for a socialist world order. But to do so, we need your help. The post An Important Message from John Bellamy Foster appeared first on MR Online .
